title: Reimagining Enterprise RAG for Multi-Agent Systems: A Knowledge Layer That Organizes Before It Retrieves
abstract: arXiv:2610.32851v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Enterprises are deploying agentic AI across the software development lifecycle, and they need the behavioral logic of the systems they act on, not stakeholder documentation. A seven-agent reverse-engineering pipeline recovered this logic, processing 241 repositories across 18 services into thousands of artifacts describing scope, journeys, rules and acceptance criteria. Recovery does not confer usability. Entities like offer, eligibility, and activation recur across services under a shared vocabulary, related in name but operationally distinct, so one end-to-end journey implicates over a thousand near-identical rules that must not be conflated. Flat vector retrieval fails, returning an identical rule from the wrong service at high similarity with no signal of error. translated_title: 面向多智能体系统的企业级RAG再造：一种先组织后检索的知识层
translated_abstract: 企业正在整个软件开发生命周期中部署智能体AI，它们需要的是其操作对象的系统行为逻辑，而非利益相关者文档。一个由七个智能体组成的逆向工程流水线恢复了这种逻辑，将18个服务中的241个代码仓库处理成数千个描述范围、用户旅程、规则和验收标准的工件。然而恢复并不等于可用性。诸如“优惠”“资格”“激活”等实体在共享词汇下跨服务反复出现，名称相关但操作语义截然不同，因此一条端到端旅程会牵涉一千多条几乎相同却绝不能混淆的规则。扁平向量检索在这种情况下失败了——它会以高相似度从错误的服务中返回相同的规则，且没有任何错误信号。传统的补救措施——内容级本体——并不存在，而将每个重复实体的所有出现都建立关联，其成本将超过项目本身的投入……
tldr: 该论文提出一种“先组织后检索”的企业RAG知识层，通过七智能体逆向工程流水线从代码仓库中恢复系统行为逻辑，并解决跨服务同名实体操作语义不同导致扁平向量检索混淆的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an enterprise RAG knowledge layer that organizes before it retrieves, using a seven-agent reverse-engineering pipeline to recover system behavioral logic from code repositories and addressing how flat vector retrieval conflates identically-named yet operationally distinct entities across services.
